Return the standard fsbrain sequential colormap.

Source: R/cbar.R
cm.seq.Rd

Return the standard fsbrain sequential colormap.

Usage

cm.seq(report = FALSE)

Arguments

report

logical, whether to print a message with a name of the chosen colormap, in format package::function#palette.

Note

This returns a sequential, multi-hue palette.
